scope: read-only original service495 equipment identification-state query; no identification settlement

provenance.original_server_formula: unknown; not needed for a read-only state query

empty_query: allow an empty ordered response after the same current NPC and role checks
duplicate_keys: preserve each occurrence in original order with the same current state; every occurrence counts toward max_items; do not sort or deduplicate the original vector
proof: owning map must freshly prove current full address, original placement and current entity key, role lease, active membership and position version; request npc_key equals all bits of that current entity key; server service binding495 is explicit, not inferred from NPC name
role_state: active and out of battle, transfer, introduction playback and other modal service; current connection/login epoch only
wire_admission: 495 is a native local menu branch. A valid c04cc query plus fresh current NPC proof and explicit service binding authorizes the query; do not require an invented preceding CNpcService495 packet. Receiving c4276 is not authorized by this query policy
inventory: current role immutable inventory snapshot from its caller's current-lease read transaction; expected inventory_revision must match. Every requested key must belong to this role, be quantity1, carried column1 with equipment_slot null, and have a supported known EquipmentDetail with identified exactly0 or1. Unknown, warehouse, worn, foreign or absent instances reject the whole query
supported_profile: only existing known clean ordinary six-slot non-god-weapon details represented by current equipment-detail.1 and its supported templates. A query does not assert that identification would keep or generate these properties
response: preserve requested order and current identified0/1; original full npc_key and mode1; validate native reply before ending the read transaction; stale proof/deadline/version or late encoding failure yields no response
writes: none: no detail initialization, identified change, hidden-property generation, inventory revision bump, wallet, receipt, chapter, binding, condition or role resource changes; no schema migration is needed
future_settlement: separate versioned policy required for c4276, fee currency, exact level/type mapping, random additional properties, binding and atomic settlement. Official2013 text supports random additional attributes; changing identified alone is not full restoration
startup: load once and freeze before map/role admission; verify original definition/placement, original495 label and the current detail rules; no hot-path file reads
activation: NPC-owned domain implementation and temporary-store/native verification authorized; shared registry and runtime routing remain a separately reviewed integration slice
